component: Control rail attached to the primary region (resize handle and options menu)
explanation: CaissaTrainer Phase 2 (CHESS-WORKSPACE.md, frontend/src/workspace). Observed: controls about the primary region (four size buttons in a page toolbar) sat far from what they act on and competed with the page toolbar, which should hold only page level things (title, one labelled toggle per panel). Phase 2 attached a control rail to the region itself: a resize handle that is a slider (drag, arrows, Home, End) and one labelled options menu holding the discrete actions (larger, smaller, largest that fits, restore). The rail follows the region, is quiet at rest (0.78 opacity, full on hover or focus, full on touch), sits beside the region on wide layouts and below it when stacked, and its width is reserved on both sides so the equal reserve keeps the region centered. Generalizes: any app with an image, canvas, preview, map or board region. Extends FB-0014 (resizable primary region), which assumed toolbar size buttons. Tension: the four toolbar buttons were an open owner question in PR-0002 (P10); the rail answers it with one menu. Controls in the menu must remain reachable by keyboard and touch (menu button pattern, 40px coarse targets). PHASE 4 UPDATE (CaissaTrainer Phase 4, recorded as FB-0042): where the rail controls sit. The Phase 2 and 3 rail floated two transparent icon buttons beside the region with no container, and they looked detached from it. Corrected: one narrow rectangular column (32px, --s2 surface) exactly as tall as the region, 8px from its right edge, options control on the region top edge and resize control on the bottom edge, one horizontal alignment, measured from the region box and never from page coordinates; a compact row under the region aligned to its right edge when stacked. This refines the rail and does not contradict it: it still lives beside the region, is quiet at rest and reserves 40px (8px gap plus the 32px column) on both sides. Classification and candidate wording: FB-0042.

classification.rationale: No principle or preset says where controls about a region live. Gap in approved guidance, not a failure to apply it. Suggested: extend candidate P23 with a control rail rule and add the rail to preset.workspace. Owner confirmation needed.
